name: Wheelluck AI Powered Popups
author: Wheelluck

sections.description:
WheelLuck turns leaving visitors into customers by capturing their attention with a fun spin-to-win wheel. Show timely offers when shoppers are most likely to abandon their cart, creating a final incentive to complete their purchase. Design your wheel and set rules in minutes, with no coding required, to recover lost sales and build your email list.

  • Build your email list with flexible reward options
  • Capture exit-intent traffic with automatically triggered wheels
  • Show personalized rewards based on customer behavior
  • No coding needed – visually customize wheel designs and rules
  • Track performance with built-in analytics and conversion metrics
sections.installation:
1. Download the plugin.
  2. Upload it to the wp-content/plugins/ directory or upload as zip through the WordPress admin panel.
  3. Activate it from the “Plugins” section in the WordPress admin panel.
  4. Click the “Enable” button from the notification box that appears in the admin panel during initial setup to load the CDN JavaScript.
  5. You can access the dashboard by clicking the “Wheelluck” submenu in the WordPress admin menu.
sections.changelog:
1.2.0

  • Redirect to Wheelluck dashboard after plugin activation

1.1.0

  • Redesigned admin dashboard with a modern, compact two-column layout (Subscription + Credit Usage).
  • Added Quick Actions section with shortcuts to Edit Promotion, View Statistics, Manage Payments and Help & Contact.
  • Integrated new promotion API to power the Edit Promotion and View Statistics shortcuts.
  • Replaced text logo with the Wheelluck brand mark.
  • Inline SVG icons across the dashboard for crisp rendering.

1.0.2

  • Initial release
